references.text: SYNTHETIC TEST PROFILE. Alex studied design in Madison, Wisconsin, before moving to Portland.
Alex collects handmade ceramics and photographs ordinary shop windows on weekend walks.
Alex starts with a pencil sketch and keeps a drawer of paper scraps used for color studies.
Alex grew up near the Oregon coast and spent summers helping a relative repair wooden boats.

Example Studio began in 2015 with two people sharing a small workspace. The practice now focuses on homes and neighborhood cafes. The team uses a weekly sample-table discussion to develop ideas together.

At Garden House, the living room was planned around a dining table the family already owned. A lower sofa kept the view toward the garden open. The team tested the turning space using a full-size paper template. The reading corner pairs a woven chair with a small ceramic lamp.

The Garden House kitchen uses clay tiles and oak shelves. A glazed tile sample was tested beside the window at different times of day. The client wanted to keep everyday dishes within reach. The team left a section of the wall without upper cabinets to bring light farther into the room.
